description: Disclosure of all remote/external API calls used by this project, as required by the QVAC Hackathon I official rules.
summary: This project makes zero remote AI inference API calls. All AI inference (text generation, RAG/embeddings, transcription) runs on-device via the QVAC SDK (@qvac/sdk), using locally downloaded GGUF models. No cloud AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) is used at any point.

nonAiNetworkActivity.description: On first run only, model weight files (GGUF format) are downloaded once from Hugging Face and cached locally on disk. No inference, prompts, or user data are sent over the network during this process — only the model files themselves are fetched.
nonAiNetworkActivity.note: Once models are downloaded and cached, the application runs with zero network/internet dependency. This download step is a one-time setup cost, not part of normal operation.
